The '''Imperial Engineering Volunteer''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who had undergone "''outstanding engineering support to the Empire during conflict.''"

One such badge was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Engineering Volunteer appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
